title: AI is great at porting!
author: flyinghorselabs
selftext:
Hi all!  I'm an enthusiast who collects an MS-DOS compatible, but NOT IBM compatible computer from the 80s, the Texas Instruments Professional.  Thanks to my little agent buddies, I've been able to port the open source Micropolis to it, creating the first game designed for the platform since... probably the 80s.

This opens up so many avenues for platforms that never got the attention they deserved, or maybe didn't, but who cares.  I'm building a Koei-style strategy game for the TIPC next, but after that?  Maybe the Neo Geo, maybe the TG16, who knows?
